name: claimforge-gold-v1
description: Frozen gold claims for the Day 5 rubric. Each item is a claim plus an inline evidence pack. Passages are synthetic illustrations of the rubric, not copied abstracts. claimforge eval reads this file only: it does not fetch OpenAlex, arXiv, or Semantic Scholar, and it does not call an LLM. The strict accuracy threshold is 1.0 because every expected_label matches the rubric. Override it with --min-accuracy.

items.note: Two catalogs restate the claim with support cues and high ranker scores.

claim.text: Physics-informed neural networks reduce the error on the Burgers equation.

evidence.title: PINNs on Burgers
evidence.snippet: This study supports the finding that physics-informed neural networks reduce the error on the Burgers equation.

evidence.title: Burgers benchmarks
evidence.snippet: We confirm that physics-informed neural networks reduce the error on the Burgers equation.

items.note: The snippets use the claim verb reduces and do not use the word support.

claim.text: Metformin reduces fasting glucose in adults with type 2 diabetes.

evidence.title: Metformin trial
evidence.snippet: A randomized trial found that metformin reduces fasting glucose in adults with type 2 diabetes.

evidence.title: Glucose follow-up
evidence.snippet: Follow-up data show metformin reduces fasting glucose in adults with type 2 diabetes.

items.note: Support phrases plus two catalogs clear the support rule.

claim.text: mRNA vaccines reduce hospitalization risk for influenza in older adults.

evidence.title: Influenza hospitalization
evidence.snippet: Evidence that mRNA vaccines reduce hospitalization risk for influenza in older adults.

evidence.title: Older-adult cohort
evidence.snippet: A cohort study supports that mRNA vaccines reduce hospitalization risk for influenza in older adults.

items.note: Both snippets come from OpenAlex. Two snippets from one catalog score coverage 0.75, which still clears support.

claim.text: Statins lower low-density lipoprotein cholesterol in adults.

evidence.title: LDL trial
evidence.snippet: This study supports that statins lower low-density lipoprotein cholesterol in adults.

evidence.title: LDL replication
evidence.snippet: A replication confirms that statins lower low-density lipoprotein cholesterol in adults.

items.note: Refute cues and adequate relevance. Coverage is not required for refute.

claim.text: Aspirin reduces headache risk in adults.

evidence.title: Aspirin review
evidence.snippet: A review does not support that aspirin reduces headache risk in adults.

evidence.title: Headache contradiction
evidence.snippet: Results contradict the claim that aspirin reduces headache risk in adults.

items.note: The snippets flip reduce to increase, which is the opposite direction.

claim.text: Physics-informed neural networks reduce the error on the Burgers equation.

evidence.title: Burgers error increases
evidence.snippet: Physics-informed neural networks increase the error on the Burgers equation.

evidence.title: Higher Burgers error
evidence.snippet: Experiments found physics-informed neural networks increase the error on the Burgers equation.

items.note: No-effect and no-significant cues vote refute when the snippet still shares claim terms.

claim.text: Vitamin D supplements improve bone density in healthy adults.

evidence.title: Bone density trial
evidence.snippet: A trial found no significant change: vitamin D supplements do not improve bone density in healthy adults.

evidence.title: Supplement review
evidence.snippet: Results show no effect of vitamin D supplements on bone density in healthy adults.

items.note: An empty pack has no relevance, coverage, or stance.

claim.text: CRISPR base editing corrects the sickle-cell mutation in hematopoietic stem cells.

items.note: High ranker scores on off-topic snippets do not create a stance vote.
